classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b is read inside the separate _prefetch process via probe.read_staged and pushed onto the queue while the main process concurrently runs its own read/sleep loop, so the read overlaps with computation rather than blocking any rank, and each index i is read exactly once by the prefetch worker.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In measure(), the main loop calls probe.read_staged(path_for(...,'class_a',...)) synchronously and only proceeds to sleep_seconds(compute_s) after it returns, so the invoking rank stalls on this single read per index i while no other rank is involved in the wait.
